| `IdentityProviderService` | `proto/api/v1/idp_service.proto` (line 14) |
| `InstanceService` | `proto/api/v1/instance_service.proto` (line 17) |
| `MemoService` | `proto/api/v1/memo_service.proto` (line 17) |
| `ShortcutService` | `proto/api/v1/shortcut_service.proto` (line 14) |
